mcqs.question: As part of the Chandranna Vidyut Velugulu programme, what additional measure was announced for the tribal families of Kodurupadu?
options: Issuance of land titles following the Bhagat Singh Colony model
Allocation of ₹9,139 crore for the entire State
Provision of 24-hour three-phase uninterrupted power to rural areas
Coverage of 26 areas, with 17 completed and 9 nearing completion
mcqs.explanation: Land titles were to be provided to the tribal families of Kodurupadu following the Bhagat Singh Colony model. The other options refer to the programme’s statewide allocation, its power-supply aim, and its area-wise progress, not the additional measure for tribal families.
